content.prompt:
Sketch the following on a number line.
$\bigl((-\infty,0)\cup(0,\infty)\bigr)\cap\bigl((-\infty,2)\cup(2,\infty)\bigr)$

answer.worked:
The first bracket contains all real numbers except $0$. The second contains all real numbers except $2$. Their intersection therefore contains every real number except these two points:
$$(-\infty,0)\cup(0,2)\cup(2,\infty).$$
Draw open circles at $0$ and $2$.

spec.description: Real line with hollow holes at 0 and 2.
